data.name: Nakul Sharma
data.intro: Final-year B.Tech student building practical machine learning projects end to end. Looking for fresher and internship roles in AI/ML, Data Science and Data Analytics.
data.about: I am a final-year Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence) student at ABES Institute of Technology, Ghaziabad. I learn by building: I like taking a problem, working through the data, training and testing models, and putting the result behind a simple app or API.

projects.title: Fake News / Clickbait Detection
projects.desc: NLP project on news articles using lemmatization, TF-IDF and POS features with Logistic Regression and LinearSVC, with ablation tests to check for data leakage.

projects.title: Credit Card Fraud Detection
projects.desc: Compares Random Forest and XGBoost on a heavily imbalanced dataset, using SMOTE and judging results with ROC-AUC and precision-recall.

projects.title: Loan Defaulter Prediction
projects.desc: Credit risk prediction on a synthetic dataset with several models tested, served through a FastAPI backend and a dark-theme web UI.

projects.title: Solar AI (Final-Year Project)
projects.tech: SAM / U-Net, NASA POWER API, XGBoost
projects.desc: Group project that assesses rooftop solar potential using image segmentation, irradiance data and a savings prediction model.

projects.title: CreditStore
projects.desc: E-commerce store where every user gets 2,000 credit points to spend.
